newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet after Dow's big day.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading quiet after Dow's big day.

text.p: Trading was quiet after Thursday's U.S. market close, in sharp contrast to the active trading during regular hours that produced a fifth consecutive record finish for blue chip stocks.
"There's nothing much going on here," a trader said when asked if any stock was trading out of line with its closing price.
In regular trading, however, the Dow industrials shot up 136 points to an unofficial close of 7711, spurred on by a drop in long-term interest rates on the bond market.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume dipped to 3,500 on Thursday from 19,900 the previous day. Session two volume also slumped to 361,324 from 11,366,416 on Wednesday.
